claim: Combines learnable latent generative decoding with reparameterized amortized variational posterior inference.
claim_zh: 将可学习的潜变量生成模型与重参数化、摊销式变分后验推断结合。
innovation_detail: Combines learnable latent generative decoding with reparameterized amortized variational posterior inference.
innovation_detail_zh: 将可学习的潜变量生成模型与重参数化、摊销式变分后验推断结合。
bottleneck: Latent generative models can have intractable posterior inference and expensive gradient estimates.
bottleneck_zh: 潜变量生成模型常面临后验不可解析和随机梯度估计开销等困难。
tradeoff: Variational families and learned decoder support can misrepresent the true physical distribution.
